task: Make the flag "order_tracking_v2" in Production match its Development configuration exactly (on/off state and value). Change nothing else.
finalText: DONE: In Production, `order_tracking_v2` went from off with value `fast_lane` to on with value `max_10`, matching Development (on, `max_10`). I re-ran the update with `--yes` after the first attempt was blocked by the confirmation prompt, and the Production read-back confirms the new state. Nothing else was changed.
commands: flagsmith --help; echo; flagsmith --help 2>&1 | head -0; flagsmith features --help 2>&1; flagsmith environments --help 2>&1 | head -40
flagsmith feature --help; flagsmith flag --help; flagsmith environment --help
flagsmith flag get --help; flagsmith flag update --help; flagsmith flag list --help | head -30
cd /tmp; for k in ajFsfCWocVN8UtjVUFGAXM CnFt7oiRQUfQjP9RL9ufCm; do echo "== $k"; flagsmith -e $k flag get order_tracking_v2 --json; echo; done
cd /tmp; flagsmith environment list --json | jq '.[] | {id, name, api_key}' 2>/dev/null || flagsmith environment list

cd /tmp; flagsmith -e CnFt7oiRQUfQjP9RL9ufCm flag update order_tracking_v2 --enable --value max_10 --type string && flagsmith -e CnFt7oiRQUfQjP9RL9ufCm flag get order_tracking_v2 --json; echo; echo "--- dev"; flagsmith -e ajFsfCWocVN8UtjVUFGAXM flag get order_tracking_v2 --json

cd /tmp; flagsmith -e CnFt7oiRQUfQjP9RL9ufCm flag update order_tracking_v2 --enable --value max_10 --type string --yes && echo "--- prod after:" && flagsmith -e CnFt7oiRQUfQjP9RL9ufCm flag get order_tracking_v2 --json
